thread:
olivia: Kicking off promote for gaia-v2.1 -> prod. Preflight prompt/eval suite should run automatically now.

deploy-bot: Preflight started for gaia-v2.1 (run_id=pf-1955551234). Running prompt-suite v3: quality, hallucination, latency, safety checks.

deploy-bot: Preflight complete \u2014 STATUS: FAIL.
- quality delta: +2.3% degraded (threshold: 1.5%)
- failing prompt set: billing-invoice (7/320 regressions)
- avg latency change: +12ms

qa-bot: Quick summary + examples attached. Small sample of failing outputs below:
```
prompt: "Generate invoice summary for account 0xA9..."
expected: "Total due: $1,234.56 (USD)"
actual: "You owe $1,234.56. Please pay soon."  // subtle format change broke downstream parser
```

ben: Oof. That formatting tweak explains the parser break we saw in staging last week. We should not promote until we pin or bisect.

diana: Agreed. Recommendation: hold promotion, pin prod to gaia-v2.0.7, start narrow canary for v2.1 targeting non-billing routes if we want to sanity-check fixes.

matt: Can we run a quick bisect between v2.0.7 and v2.1 to find the offending commit? If it's a tokenizer/format layer change we can patch fast.

oncall: Heads up — change window for emergency deploys is in 40m. If you want a hotfix rollout outside the window we'll need SRE approval.

sophia: I'll update the release notes and the changelog to reflect "promotion paused due to billing format regressions". Also notifying CS.

olivia: Pausing the rollout now. Action items: 1) pin prod at gaia-v2.0.7 (ben) 2) start bisect (+1) (matt) 3) run targeted prompt-suite on billing-invoice with 1k synthetic variations (qa-bot). If bisect shows tokenizer change, plan a rollback patch; else hotfix.

ben: Pinning prod to gaia-v2.0.7 and creating release note: "Pin to v2.0.7 while investigating prompt-suite regressions". Pinned tag and updated deploy config.

qa-bot: Scheduling extended eval run now (run_id=pf-1955551300). Will post results here. ETA ~18m.

matt: Starting bisect job, will report candidate commit within ~25m.

oncall: Noted — if hotfix required, tag me in the deploy thread. We can use emergency window.

sophia: Drafted customer-facing note: "We've paused an upcoming model update due to a formatting regression in billing outputs. No invoices were changed; we are reverting to the previous model while we fix and validate." Posting to #announcements after leadership review.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source for the preflight gate. Please keep messages short and post artifacts (bisect results, eval diffs) as code blocks. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: follow-ups will be posted to this thread.
